scenarios.name: Sort recent rows by name and carry the order into Grid View

scenario_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native`
the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
recent documents with different names are displayed in List View
Last Opened is the active descending sort
the user selects the Name column header
the visible rows are ordered by name in descending order
a downward sort indicator appears in the Name header
the user selects the Name column header again
the visible rows are ordered by name in ascending order
the Name header shows an upward sort indicator
the user switches to Grid View
Sort by shows Name with an upward direction indicator
the visible cards follow the ascending name order
